bards.page_desc: Configure how NPC bards perform songs: AI-composed ones written from world events and NPC memory, and songs you import from audio files.
bards.enabled.label: Enable Bard Singing
bards.compose_enabled.label: Compose New Songs With AI
bards.compose_enabled.hint_on: Bards compose new songs with the music provider below.
bards.compose_enabled.hint_off: Bards sing only imported and existing songs. No new songs are composed.
bards.suno.desc: Generate sung performances via sunoapi.org. Requires an API key.
bards.suno.base_url_hint: API gateway endpoint. Only change this if routing through a custom proxy.
bards.suno.model_hint: Suno model version. V5 is the current default; older versions remain for compatibility.
bards.nano_gpt.desc: Generate music via NanoGPT. Requires a NanoGPT API key.
bards.openrouter.desc: Generate music via OpenRouter. Requires an OpenRouter API key.
bards.acestep_cloud.desc: Generate music via the AceMusic cloud API (acemusic.ai). Requires an AceMusic API key.
bards.acestep_local.desc: Generate music via a self-hosted AceStep server.
bards.acestep_local.base_url_hint: Full chat-completions URL of your AceStep server (e.g. http://localhost:8002/v1/chat/completions).
bards.acestep_local.model_hint: Model ID your local server exposes (default: acemusic/acestep-v1.5-turbo).
bards.minimax.desc: Generate music via MiniMax (api.minimax.io). Requires a MiniMax API key.
bards.playback_volume_hint: Volume bards sing at, relative to other in-game audio.
bards.playback_volume_hint_engine: Controlled by the SkyrimNet Bards slider in Skyrim's Audio settings when Use Skyrim Audio Engine is enabled.
bards.interval_hours_hint: How often (in game hours) to attempt generating a new song. Each generation costs API credits.
bards.max_cached_songs_hint: AI-composed songs to keep cached per save. Oldest is evicted (FIFO) once the cap is hit. Imported songs are never evicted and don't count.
bards.default_style_hint: Comma-separated style tags the provider uses to flavor the generation.
bards.negative_tags_hint: Style elements to AVOID — comma-separated. Useful for keeping bardic music away from modern genres.
bards.language_hint: Language the vocals are sung in. Used by AceStep providers only; other providers ignore this setting.
bards.songs.title: Songs
bards.songs.empty: No songs yet. Songs bards compose in-game appear here, or import one from an audio file.
bards.songs.delete_confirm: Permanently delete "{{title}}"? The audio file and database row will be removed.
bards.songs.search_placeholder: Search songs by title, composer, or lyrics…
bards.songs.no_match: No songs match the current filter.
bards.import.title: Import a song
bards.import.desc: Add an audio file to this save's songs. Bards sing it like a composed song.
bards.import.audio_hint: .mp3, .wav, .ogg or .flac, up to 50 MB. A .yaml song file with the same name beside it fills in the fields below.
bards.import.audio_hint_browser: .mp3, .wav, .ogg or .flac, up to 50 MB. To fill in the fields below from its .yaml song file (same name), select both files together.
bards.import.record_without_audio: Select the audio file too, not only its .yaml song file.
bards.import.instrumental_hint: No vocals: any bard can play it, whatever the bard's voice.
bards.import.voice_hint: Bards with this voice sing the song.
bards.import.lyrics_hint: Optional. Shown as the bard sings, and used to find the song when someone asks for it.
bards.import.mine_hint: Only you perform it (with /playsong). NPC bards won't pick it on their own.
bards.import.record_error.not_mapping: {{name}} must be a YAML mapping of fields.
bards.import.record_error.bad_id: The id in {{name}} may only use letters, digits, - and _.
bards.test.composing_off: Turn on composing to test the provider
